Cores are the building blocks that define how items flow in your ME network. Two types:

§bFormation Core§f (placing items into inventories):
- Storage Bus, Import Bus, ME Pattern Provider (output side)
- Formation Plane

§bAnnihilation Core§f (extracting items from inventories):
- Export Bus, ME Pattern Provider (input side)
- Molecular Assembler
- Annihilation Plane

Both require Processors and Pure Crystals to craft. Every bus and plane that touches an external inventory needs a Core, so plan production in proportion to your automation scale.

§ePS:§f Formation goes in, Annihilation comes out. Remember that and you will never mix them up.
